Every bound SENT_EVENT and DONE_EVENT triggers the immediate No-Idle rescan in Diagram 3b.
COMPLETED_RECONCILED is terminal evidence, not a live lane.
Transitions marked CANDIDATE are this document's inferences.
No ratified source defines a full transition matrix.
